access_description: Bank of England Database CSV download documented on the database help page. No API key. Series IUDBEDR, CSVF=CT, UsingCodes=Y, Dateto=now. Provisional data parameter VPD is not sent.
auth_requirement: No API key. The help page documents a public CSV URL.
conditions: Acknowledge the Bank of England under the Open Government Licence v3.0. This row is only IUDBEDR, Official Bank Rate. Selected exchange-rate series are excluded from the Database licence and are not requested. Provisional data is not requested.
revision_behaviour: The CSV is the current published series, not a historical vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Days absent from the file, and values marked .., are omitted and are not stored as zero.
unresolved_questions: The Open Government Licence does not name AI processing or model training.
evidence_note: The Bank legal page states: Reproduction of data in the Database is subject to the terms of the UK Open Government Licence, allowing and encouraging free and flexible data reuse. It also states that selected exchange rate data and series are excluded from this licence. The Bank Rate history page names series IUDBEDR as Official Bank Rate and labels the chart Bank Rate %. The Open Government Licence permits commercial exploitation with attribution. The database help page says VPD=Y need only be included if provisional data is desired, so it is not sent. A non-persisting fetch on 2026-10-24 contained 13097 daily observations from 02 Jan 1975 to 22 Oct 2026. It is not a historical vintage panel. The stored class is latest-revised. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000.
